subject: The author queue taken up: Addendum C carries the twenty-five answers into the block (wardrobe rows for Card D and Card B, the verse order, the ice, the authorship line); items 14 to 17 answered (delta v4); the opening reissued for a notebook round under the maturity gate; the panel-view proposal held for your return
body: The author queue is taken up: Addendum C (attached) carries all twenty-five answers of the October 30 interview into the block without a new field. For the site: the wardrobe table your record holds under storyboardSOPHandback is written as design_reference rows of 11.2 (Card D) with shot scopes and each portrait's review state as review_decisions.json reads today (the yellow jacket needs fixes at detailed design, likeness 3; the bomber, the fur coat and the ivory coat have no entry; the boss keep, production; the bouncer and the iced grill no entry), and the transitions as 11.8 context lines (Card B); the first verse displays as S02-3, S02-2, S02-4 with stable ids; the authorship line in 11.1 is the per-section maturity record your reconciliation of the hard-coded Preliminary can read; and every block from here on carries a panel-picture line in 11.3 for the panel view. Items 14 to 17 of the task are answered by the interview (card delta v4, attached, additive to v3; no new question). The passages table (attached) lists the 848 passages the answers touch across the posted files, verified verbatim, which your adapter can read for the opening blocks, the S02 and S03 packets and the cards until each is reissued. Ziggy's direction this morning on the Hon panel view, in substance: agree with cleaning it up so it represents the seventy authored shots with the panel-flavour experience; implementation waits for your return. The proposal is attached, held, with the facts from the local master catalog and the adapter staleness to take in the same round. Separately, for the notebook round Ziggy asked for today: the opening is reissued (the round request v2 and the source text v2, attached) under the gate he set (mature material only); its dispatch is his and runs through the notebook method's own operator, not through the site. Nothing generated, uploaded, bought or edited on the site; the live JSON untouched.

attachments.description: Addendum C: the twenty-five answers of the October 30 author interview carried into the block; the wardrobe table as 11.2 rows (Card D) and 11.8 lines (Card B) with each reference's review state; the first verse's display order, the boss's wardrobe, the bouncer, the glance; the ice across S10, S11, the epilogue and the bridges; the authorship line; Round M and E held; the beat target and the pre-lap withdrawn; the binding-is-the-team's-step correction; the panel-picture line; the gate for improvement rounds; the passages superseded by file and line and the take-2 list. Proposal; nothing run.

The 848 passages of the posted writer files and the catalog that the twenty-five answers touch, each with file, lines, answer, relation (superseded, needs take 2, confirmed, context), the quoted passage verified verbatim against its file, and the finder note; the list a site adapter or a reissue reads.
Card delta v4, additive to v3: items 14 to 17 answered by the interview; three links and the publication list; the panel-view proposal linked; no new question.

Proposal for Site Nova, held for her return: the Hon panel view re-pointed at the seventy authored shots as the picture-first lens of the same object the Structure & gaps ledger shows; a picture precedence and a status vocabulary shared with the Criminal Mind cover cards; the adapter staleness to take in the same round (the opening blocks, the S03 packet, S01-1 revision B and Addendum C not ingested; eleven Kitchen blocks counted where twenty-three exist).

Improvement round, second issue (HON-IMPROVE-OPENING-CAM-002): the opening cinematography and pacing pass with the answers applied; the kitchen files moved to optional reading; the gate attested; prepared, not sent; the operator capture fields empty.

Rebuilt scope-A source text for the opening, second issue: the posted packet with every passage the answers supersede replaced in place and marked, names replaced, the kitchen lines inserted, the snapshot and manifest updated. A text Source candidate; not uploaded.

The four questions of HON-IMPROVE-OPENING-CAM-002 exactly as they are to be pasted, each under its marker line with the role paragraph verbatim; the operator's 'prompt exactly as sent' is this file byte for byte.
